description: Stage 1 criterion screen: the v14 eighth-decade lattice verbatim, re-measured under the repaired presentation draw. PRESENT-SHARE-01 (PR #825, merged 890bfce3) isolated and repaired the share-vs-hazard defect the GM H2 decomposition surfaced: the declared presentation probability (symptomatic_fraction, or the illness_probability Hill pair) is a share of courses, but the engine re-rolled it once per day of natural history while a course sat NOT_ILL -- ~15 draws to shedding clearance -- so P(never present) ~= 0 and effectively every infection presented within ~1.4 days of the incubation crossing. `presentation_draw_mode: once_per_course` now ships default (one draw at the epoch crossing the host's drawn incubation; a failed draw is a never-presenting course) and `daily_hazard` keeps the labelled pre-change baseline bit-identical. The recorded channel is exactly what this screen scores (median recorded attack on generic voyages) AND what the stage-2 clause scores (takeoff-seed recorded onsets, before_share), so the whole DP re-approach -- band and replay both -- must be re-measured on the repaired draw. The admissible set is the interior Thetas satisfying the frozen fleet_shape_selector; the conditional_trajectory_clause is then re-measured per admissible point by the companion design covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2 (committed in the same change, inside the same image). If the window is illusory the readout reports the located crossing and states that no admissible Theta exists in the bracket on this draw. No Theta on this design may be quoted as a fit until stage 2 passes.
supersedes: covid_theta_screen_v14 as the stage-1 fleet-shape surface of record: its rows are quoted, not re-run, as the pre-presentation-repair comparison -- every v14 cell ran under the daily_hazard spend because the fix had not yet shipped. The endpoint rows 1e11 and 1e12 ARE re-run here (not quoted) because they are the bracket boundaries and the canary's bracket verification must show the undershoot-to-overshoot crossing on the v15 image itself.
prerequisites: covid_theta_screen_v14 (PR #824, image 02740187, jobdef rev 44): admissible set {1.33e11..4.22e11} under the repaired hand line and the daily_hazard presentation spend -- 1e11 fails the floor, 5.62e11 tips over the ceiling, mean cap never binds. The conditional clause was last measured under v13 (fails at every admissible Theta; takeoff-seed q05 floors 1,770-2,024 recorded onsets, before_share 0.81-0.94); the v14 stage-2 enumeration never submitted.

PRESENT-SHARE-01 (PR #825, merged 890bfce3): once_per_course shipped default-ON; daily_hazard labelled baseline reproducing the pre-change stream bit-identically. DP detector cell repinned (2968,298,3063,627,215) -> (2575,2131,2617,688,618): recorded onsets -13%, asymptomatic campaign positives ~3x -- the direction the ~10-18x recorded-share residual needs, at detector scale.

PRESENT-SHARE-01 flag-off verifications (PR #827, merged 655b0431): the daily_hazard cells reproduce every pre-change pin exactly on the merged tree, so a v15-vs-v14 seed-paired delta attributes the surface move to the presentation repair across image builds.

Boarding structure measured closed: index window, seed count, and geometry all retired as levers (SEED-ONSET-01, COVID-SEED-GEOM-01, SEED-GEOM-V1); the v14 stage-2 surface never ran, so the conditional clause's surface of record is v13's.
voyage_mode_note: Verbatim from v11 (unchanged through v14): stage 1 cells are generic voyages, not the declared replay: the explicit seed's onset_day and departure_day are dropped, its infection age is drawn from the profile's incubation distribution (a typical voyage's introduction is not a dated case report), and the voyage runs 7 days (168 epochs on the hourly clock). Interventions never fire because every declared mechanism starts after the voyage ends (SOP-017 day 16, testing campaign day 16). Ascertainment is NOT an intervention: the scenario's molecular_ascertainment_start_day 14 is a Diamond Princess particular, and carrying it into a generic voyage leaves the recorded channel open the whole voyage -- generic cells read recorded_onsets under the always-on ascertainment the fleet anchor presumes.
thetas_note: Verbatim from v13 (unchanged through v14): the bisection lattice over the bracketed window (1e11, 1e12): the two endpoints plus the seven interior eighth-decade points. Endpoints 1e11 and 1e12 are boundary rows -- re-measured on this image for bracket verification and reported beside the interior, but per the v11 convention a boundary hit is reported, never selected on: the admissible set is drawn from the seven interior points only. If the set touches a boundary the readout says the bracket was tighter than measured, not that a boundary Theta fits.
infection_age_note: Placeholder required by the cell enumeration grammar, NOT an axis: under voyage_mode generic the import's infection age is drawn per voyage from the profile's incubation distribution and the 0.0 in the cell key (age0d) carries no meaning. Declared so a reader of the S3 prefix is not misled into reading a seeded age. Verbatim from v11.
imports_note: One import per voyage, verbatim from the v10 stage-2 block and licensed by the record (Sekizuka 2020, single introduction before quarantine). The number/timing-of-imports axis is the rejected alternative recorded under v11, not an axis of this screen.
seeds_note: 200 voyages per (Theta, arm), verbatim from the v10 stage-2 fleet-shape block (seed base 20201001, a different stream from the replay's 20200205). The Binomial standard error on a 0.25 tail share at 200 voyages is about 3%. Same seed base as covid_rebase_01, v13, and v14, so each row pairs seed-for-seed with the v14 surface for the repaired-draw attribution.

arms.note: Shipped default since PR #825 (pathogen profile presentation_draw_mode: once_per_course -- spend the declared presentation share once per course). Declared first with empty overrides per the baseline-arm convention; cells read whatever the image ships, and the resolved mode is auditable from the payload's delivery.presentation_draw_mode echo (added for this screen in covid_boarding_screen._delivery_block).

cells_note: 9 Theta x 1 arm x 200 seeds = 1,800 stage-1 cells, each a 168-epoch generic voyage (~7 min). Enumeration is axis point x arm x seed: with the single arm, Theta row r occupies indices r*200..r*200+199. The daily_hazard pairing arm is declined -- PRESENT-SHARE-01 already measured the once_per_course-vs-daily_hazard contrast with exact flag-off reproduction on the detector cells, and the seed-pairing against the v14 cells carries the same attribution at zero extra cost (the same reasoning that resolved v14 stage 1 to its single arm). Stage-2 replay cells are enumerated in covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2_design.json (committed in the same change, inside the same image) and are NOT in this count.

admissibility.note: FROZEN before any v15 cell exists, verbatim from v14 (itself verbatim from v11 via covid_rebase_01 and v13). Bimodality is not a failure criterion and its absence is not a success criterion -- covid.H3 records a median voyage attack rate of 0.2% with Diamond Princess at 712 cases, so the real fleet IS near-critical.
admissibility.h3_role_change: covid.H3 stays out of the held-out set as the stage-1 selection anchor (its v11 role change); covid.H1/H2/H5 remain held out.

fleet_shape_selector.criterion: STAGE-1 SELECTOR, verbatim from v11 (itself verbatim from the v10 stage_2_fleet_shape block): across the 200 generic voyages at each (Theta, arm), the median recorded attack rate lies within [0.0005, 0.008], the interquartile range overlaps [0.0003, 0.015], and the mean is not above 0.06.
fleet_shape_selector.target_source: covid.H3 (median 0.002, IQR 0.0003-0.015, mean 0.037; 79 ships, 104 voyages, Willebrand 2022), data/observation/covid_fit_targets.json
fleet_shape_selector.numerator: recorded_onsets / aboard_total per voyage -- the RECORDED channel, not the truth channel, verbatim from the v10 stage-2 note. Median [0.0005, 0.008] is a median of 2-30 recorded onsets on a 3,711-host hull.
fleet_shape_selector.note: An approximation, declared: the model has one hull and one voyage length, not 79 hulls and a voyage mixture, so what is compared is the SHAPE of the across-voyage distribution. Reported beside it but never thresholded: P(attack >= 0.015), P(attack >= 0.10), P(attack <= 0.01), takeoff probability, and attack-rate quantiles at 0.1/0.25/0.5/0.75/0.9. The endpoint rows carry a second declared use: bracket verification -- 1e11 must still sit below-window and 1e12 above-window on this image for the interior lattice to be a bisection rather than an extrapolation.

audit_invariants.presentation_draw_mode: delivery.presentation_draw_mode == 'once_per_course' on every cell -- the resolved draw must be the repaired spend, not the labelled baseline; a daily_hazard echo means the cell ran the wrong mechanism and invalidates the row.
audit_invariants.hand_reservoir_mode: delivery.hand_reservoir_mode == 'hygiene_cycle' on every cell -- the shipped hand line, unchanged since v14; any other resolution means the image is not the merged default.
audit_invariants.generic_voyage_contract: verbatim from v14: no onset_day and no departure_day on the explicit seed, no molecular_ascertainment_start_day override, num_epochs 168, non-degenerate recorded_onsets channel.

conditional_trajectory_clause.criterion: STAGE-2 CLAUSE, verbatim from v11: scored only at stage-1-admissible Thetas and only among takeoff seeds (recorded_onsets >= takeoff_recorded_onsets = 10) of the declared replay: the takeoff seeds' q05-q95 interval of recorded_onsets contains 197 AND the takeoff seeds' median before_share is within 0.10 of 0.173 (34/197 onsets before day 17, 6 February). The clause is scored only when a cell has >= 5 takeoff seeds; below that it is reported as 'insufficient takeoff mass', not failed.
conditional_trajectory_clause.note: Verbatim from v11. Scored on the stage-2 declared-replay cells enumerated in covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2_design.json. Reported beside it, never thresholded: the fraction of TAKEOFF seeds whose recorded_onsets lies in [98.5, 394] (mass-near-197 vs interval-spanning-197), the takeoff-seed count per row, and the full per-seed recorded_onsets and before_share vectors -- the deliverable's takeoff-mass and before_share composition table.

diagnostics.covid_T2: Reported on replay cells, never selected on: direction of the passenger and crew onset turn in the 7 days after day 16.
diagnostics.covid_T3: Reported, never used in selection: campaign positives interval against 634 and median specimens against 3,063. Demoted since v7 on saturation evidence; on this hull the campaign saturates against its own day capacities.
diagnostics.covid_T4: Reported, never used in selection: asymptomatic share among positives, target 0.5047. Emergent from delivered dose, not a natural-history parameter; it cannot be met by a choice of Theta. NOTE for v15: the presentation repair changes the composition of this channel directly (a never-presenting class now exists at drawn rate) -- the diagnostic is where that move is read.
diagnostics.fleet_shape_indicator: On replay cells, verbatim from v11: P(attack <= 0.01), takeoff fraction, P(attack >= 0.10), attack-rate quantiles -- reported so the replay's own distribution can be read against the fleet block's, declaring the conditioning-set difference (a dated symptomatic index is a stronger introduction than a drawn one).
diagnostics.burn_tail: Reported on replay cells, verbatim from v11: whether the attack-rate q05-q95 interval excludes 0.19 entirely.
diagnostics.cross_pathogen: vsp_reported_case_fraction_max and vsp_threshold_crossing_fraction carried in the payload and reported, verbatim from v11's cross_pathogen_readout block.
diagnostics.paired_vs_v14: Every lattice row pairs seed-for-seed with the covid_theta_screen_v14 cells at the same Theta: per-seed deltas on recorded_onsets and takeoff class reported as the engine-drift check between the v14 image (daily_hazard spend) and the v15 image (once_per_course), never selected on. The presentation repair is the only operative engine difference between the two images' screens; hygiene_cycle shipped default-ON on both.

stage_2_declared_replay.status: enumerated up front in covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2_design.json (same change, same image); which of its rows submit is fixed by the frozen rule below
stage_2_declared_replay.cell_shape: Verbatim from v11/covid_rebase_01_stage2 (unchanged through v14): declared replay, onset_day -1.0, departure_day 5.0, dwell_weighted sanitary visits, imports 1, infection_age_days 6.8 (declared value, a measured null axis under a declared onset_day -- carried only for cell-key bookkeeping), 20 matched seeds at base 20200205, full 32-day voyage (768 epochs). Stage-2 cells run on the shipped default (once_per_course presentation draw, hygiene_cycle hand line).
stage_2_declared_replay.theta_points: FROZEN SELECTION RULE over the stage-2 candidate rows (1e9 anchor plus the nine lattice Thetas, ascending): (a) if the stage-1 admissible set is non-empty, run the clause at every admissible Theta plus the nearest non-admissible lattice neighbour on each side of its span as boundary flanks; (b) if the set is empty but the interior medians cross the selector window inside the lattice (at least one interior row below the floor and at least one above the ceiling or over the mean cap), run the clause at the two lattice points straddling the crossing plus their adjacent interior neighbours -- boundary re-measurements, never candidates; (c) if the window is illusory (every interior row fails on the SAME side of the selector, or monotone overshoot at both ends), stage 2 does not run -- that is a report_immediately_if condition: the engine needs a mechanism, not a Theta; (d) the Theta 1e9 anchor row runs in every submitted set as the QUAR-ATTR-V2 re-measurement and canary. Endpoint rows run their replay cells only when (a) or (b) selects them, and are always reported as boundary, never selected.
stage_2_declared_replay.note: The conditional_trajectory_clause is scored only on rows this rule selects. The v13 stage-2 surface (image edb7fc41) is the comparison of record and is quoted beside whatever this stage produces (the v14 stage-2 enumeration never submitted, so no v14 stage-2 surface exists to pair against).

stage_3_held_out.status: designed, not submitted until stages 1 and 2 close
stage_3_held_out.note: Verbatim from v10/v11: scored once at the selected Theta and reported at its half-decade neighbours as sensitivity. The Greg Mortimer seed declares no onset day, so its incubation is drawn and its geometry is not an invariant there. covid.H1/H2 remain held out and are the check this screen never selected on. A miss here is a result to record, not a reason to reopen the grid. NOTE for v15: PRESENT-SHARE-01 was itself decomposed from the GM H2 leg, so the held-out GM read is the arm where the repair's effect is best understood ahead of the run.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot, per .agents/skills/aws-batch-campaign/SKILL.md, via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_theta_screen_v15. The image must be built from a main that contains this design file AND covid_theta_screen_v15_stage2_design.json; the design is read inside the container. Job definition revision and image digest pinned per campaign-preflight step 3, never a bare tag.
execution.canary: 2 cells at the midpoint row: INDEX_OFFSET 800 ARRAY_SIZE 2 (Theta 3.16e11, arm once_per_course, seeds 20201001-20201002). Checks, verbatim in spirit from v14/v13/v11: every cell's run spec carries NO onset_day and NO departure_day on its explicit seed and no molecular_ascertainment_start_day; num_epochs 168; the payload contract is unchanged; no row is degenerate; cells carry arm_id once_per_course, resolved delivery.presentation_draw_mode = once_per_course, and resolved delivery.hand_reservoir_mode = hygiene_cycle. Assess the canary readout before committing the full lattice; on a clean read the remaining 1,798 cells proceed as nine 200-child arrays at INDEX_OFFSET {0,200,...,1600} (canary cells skip via _already_complete), the user having directed this campaign contingent on the canary.
execution.report_immediately_if: the bracket contains no admissible point on the shipped arm -- monotone overshoot or monotone undershoot at both endpoints, i.e. the window is illusory and the engine needs a mechanism, not a Theta; the admissible set is non-empty only at a boundary endpoint (a boundary hit is reported, never selected); the fleet takeoff transition sits outside the bracket (zero takeoff at 1e12 or saturation at 1e11); any stage-1 cell's run spec carries a declared onset_day or departure_day, or echoes presentation_draw_mode != once_per_course or hand_reservoir_mode != hygiene_cycle; the v15-vs-v14 seed-paired deltas are suppression-shaped outside the stream-reorder band; or the child failure rate exceeds 5%.

rejected_alternatives.sequential_midpoint_bisection: REJECTED as the submission plan, not as the measurement (verbatim from v14): one-midpoint-at-a-time bisection serialises the same information into ~30-min array+readout cycles per halving level and loses the per-seed pairing between every adjacent lattice point. The eighth-decade lattice contains every bisection path to the same depth, costs one array pass, and pairs seed-for-seed with the v14, v13, and rebase_01 endpoints.
rejected_alternatives.deeper_than_eighth_decade_lattice: Not this stage: sixteenth-decade points are gated on the eighth-decade surface showing a crossing that the selector resolves -- if interior rows all fail on one side the deeper lattice measures nothing, and if the clause passes at an admissible point the refit is done at lattice precision per the v11 convention.
rejected_alternatives.quoting_v14_endpoints: REJECTED: the endpoints are the bracket itself -- the canary's bracket verification must observe the undershoot-to-overshoot crossing on the v15 image, not infer it across image builds.
rejected_alternatives.daily_hazard_pairing_arm: Adding the labelled baseline as a second arm (3,600 cells) would re-measure, in-image, a contrast PRESENT-SHARE-01 already measured with exact flag-off reproduction on the GM and DP detector cells; the seed-paired read against the v14 cells (same seeds, same lattice) carries the same attribution at half the cost -- the same resolution v14 took against its own spike_decay pairing.
rejected_alternatives.direct_stage2_without_stage1: Skipping the lattice and re-running only the replay at the v14 admissible set cannot say whether the admissible set itself moved: the recorded channel the selector scores is exactly the channel the presentation repair shrinks, so the band must be re-admitted before the clause is scored at its points.
